_doc: Post-game wild tables (postgame_dex, 2026-11-09; user decision 2026-11-09, notes/DECISIONS.md; notes/POSTGAME.md 'Post-game dex completion'). After the Champion (FLAG_SYS_GAME_CLEAR) a zone whose encounter file is a key of a version's 'maps' reads that map's post-game twin instead: the same table with the slot edits below (the other version's exclusive in some of this version's slots). converter/gen_postgame_encounters.py writes the twins (src/encounters[/ruby|/emerald]/NNNN_pg_<Map>.s); b2tools/patches/postgame_encounters.py gives the decomp's resident C (src/hoennb2/resident/postgame_enc.c) the {file -> twin} pairs and the Pokedex area page's post-game cells. 'files': every map's twin id in a/1/2/7, FIXED once given, shared by all versions (Unova ids no zone of any version uses: their sizes stay, so the archive's layout does not change; maps whose twins are the same table share an id). 'maps' (this file: Sapphire; data/ruby/ and data/emerald/ hold Ruby's and Emerald's, each REPLACING the whole 'maps', never merged): per section (grass, surf, fishing, rippling_fishing) slot index -> species, the slot's levels kept (they are the other version's levels for that slot, already on data/level_scaling.json's curve: the generator checks them against 'from', the version whose table has that species in that slot), or [species, Gen 3 min, Gen 3 max] for levels of its own (scaled by the curve). Slot odds are fixed per slot, so every table still sums to 100 %. Splits give the other version's exclusive every slot that keeps the two closest, the version's own species first (largest slots first).
